2610.13807.title: Error Rate is Not Enough: Costs of Augmentation in Low-Resource ASR
2610.13807.paper_summary: Data augmentation is standard practice for low-resource automatic speech recognition (ASR), but its benefits are almost always reported as aggregate error rates, leaving open why and when a method helps. On four low-resource languages and English at five data sizes, we cross two augmentations that modify existing audio (speed perturbation and SpecAugment) with two that modify text transcriptions and synthesize audio from it. We analyze errors at the phoneme level and find that they help for complementary reasons. SpecAugment has the most reliable aggregate improvements, but increases tone and palatalization errors, whereas text-based methods introduce consonant insertions; in combination, each reduces the errors the other introduces. This complementarity is predictable. Tone and palatalization are each signaled by a single acoustic property and occur least frequently in training (lowest training exposure), and text-based methods that flatten word frequency raise their frequency by 37--38%, reversing those errors while further improving aggregate error. The improvement from combining the methods exceeds the sum of their individual improvements; the superadditivity vanishes by 100 hours, limiting the complementarity to the low-resource regime. Where specific error types matter, we recommend selecting augmentation by training exposure and acoustic properties, both measurable before any training.
2610.13807.paper_summary_zh: 資料增強是低資源自動語音識別（ASR）的標準做法，但其好處幾乎總是以總體錯誤率報告，未能解釋為何及何時某種方法有效。在四種低資源語言和五種數據規模的英語中，我們交叉了兩種修改現有音頻的增強方法（速度擾動和SpecAugment）與兩種修改文本轉錄並從中合成音頻的方法。我們在音素層面分析錯誤，發現它們因互補原因而有幫助。SpecAugment具有最可靠的總體改進，但增加了音調和腭化錯誤，而基於文本的方法則引入了輔音插入；這兩者結合在一起，各自減少了對方引入的錯誤。這種互補性是可預測的。音調和腭化各由單一的聲學特性信號表示，並且在訓練中出現的頻率最低（最低的訓練暴露），而基於文本的方法通過平坦化單詞頻率將其頻率提高了37-38%，從而逆轉這些錯誤，同時進一步改善總體錯誤。結合這些方法所帶來的改進超過了它們各自改進的總和；這種超加性在100小時後消失，限制了互補性在低資源範疇內的應用。在特定錯誤類型重要的情況下，我們建議根據訓練暴露和聲學特性選擇增強方法，這兩者在任何訓練之前都是可測量的。
2610.13807.author: Katsumi Ibaraki et.al.
